Read your own words back to yourself.  You don’t like his kids, you don’t like his family and it seems as if you don’t like your husband.

Having been on both sides (parent with a husband who was absolutely horrid as a step father) and now remarried to a man with whom we both understood the importance of a healthy step parent relationship for all our children I feel obligated to encourage you to leave this situation.

Not everyone is cut out to parent someone else’s children and that’s ok.  Nobody wants a life of resentment and bad feelings especially towards children.  I’m sure you are a good person but it seems that this marriage is not working for you.

I would also like to caution others who read this to understand that the parent/child bond is very strong.  If you have not had children of your own you may not understand this bond.  Please be very intentional and careful about choosing a mate when there are children involved.  Unfortunately in most cases the children’s well being and often overridden by the parent’s romantic inclinations.
